Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S12 The credential the browser gets for dictation: signed-in only, 60 s, never the long-lived key; the transcription log names the model

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (UAT OAT-05 step 3; TFA-94423 AC 1)
  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)
  • U9 Each run records which AI ran each step: the note model, the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when ambient is on), and the models for pre-round processing, photo capture and A … (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1; TFA-94423 AC 7)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The UAT commit's convex/ai/transcribe.ts, src/lib/speech/liveSession.ts and e2e/unit/live-session-action.unit.ts, in the QA worktree

When Run locally (npx playwright test -c e2e/unit.config.ts -g '<title>') the live-session-action.unit.ts tests 'anonymous session creation is refused before contacting OpenAI', 'backend fixes the model and returns only an ephemeral credential with safe audit metadata', 'provider failure cannot leak credentials or raw requ …

Then An anonymous caller gets nothing, and OpenAI is never contacted for it. A signed-in caller gets only a secret that expires 60 s after it is created, for model gpt-live-transcribe, and the diagnostics row names gpt-live-transcribe. The long-lived key never appears in the response, the audit or diagnostics rows, or a provider-failure message. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 3 'not a … unauthenticated call', step 1, and UAT 3.9 for the transcription log. Each of the four unit tests is green and the code read matches. A lifetime over 60 s, an anonymous success, the key in any output, or a recovery logged under the wrong model is a Fail. The anonymous-refusal test for every ai.* action (api/actions.spec.ts) is S26.
